reply_text:
Found two issues in `receipt-lines` against `main`:

*CRITICAL*
• *Printed amounts are 100× too high* — `receipt/render.py:2` formats cents directly as dollars: `format_money(1299)` returns `$1299.00`, not `$12.99`.
  *Fix:* Convert cents to dollars before formatting. Add literal expected-output assertions; `tests/test_render.py:10` currently uses the same broken formatter to compute its expectation.

*INFORMATIONAL*
• *Amounts aren’t right-aligned in rendered receipts* — `receipt/render.py:7` pads the name to 20 characters instead of using the new 32-column `align()` helper. Different-length amounts end in different columns.
  *Fix:* Call `align(line['name'], format_money(total))` and test `render_line()` with different amount lengths, asserting a consistent right edge.

All 3 existing tests pass. No files changed.
